query: I just got back from walking my golden retriever this morning and he was so excited to chase a squirrel that he dragged me straight through a puddle, I had to change my socks as soon as I got home. Then I remembered I forgot to water my pothos plant that's been sitting on my windowsill, I think it's been looking a little wilted lately because I've been so busy with work this week. Oh, and I also need to pick up a new pack of my favorite peach iced tea from the grocery store later, the one I usually get has been out of stock for two weeks now. Anyway, I need to modify my pending order #W5061109, please change the item 3694871183 to item 6077640618, and use paypal_3742148 as the payment method for this adjustment.
